projects.title: Fish and Orchard
projects.subtitle: Spatial Design & Brand Identity System
projects.description:
Like the first brick laid upon the foundation, this marks the beginning of an unwritten story. These sharp lines are more than just geometry-they are the imprint of thought, a balance between structure and creativity, between order and freedom.

It resembles a house in the making, but it could also be an unfinished structure, an idea taking form, a journey just beginning. The slanted edges are not instability, but momentum-movement, the first step forward.

I don’t know where the future will take me. But I know 2025 is a milestone. At 27, or maybe just the 25-year-old full of fire, gathering every effort, every ounce of dedication to create something meaningful.

I started with the idea of sustainability, learning to see cities like a doctor sees a patient-diagnosing before prescribing. I don’t want to simply create and let things fade away. I want to tell their stories, to document my path, in case one day I forget who I was, what I started with, what I dreamed of, and why I had to keep going.

The red is fire, energy, a heartbeat pulsing within calculated edges. The black is a foundation, a challenge, the things I must face. The white-empty yet full of potential-is the space for possibilities, for questions waiting to be answered.

I call my creations oranges. I am the one who plants them. A small fish planting oranges-an odd image, perhaps. But someday, someone will cherish the fruits I grow.

I am a dreamer. I break the expectations placed upon me. I am not perfect. I fear judgment. But I still do, I still write, I still create.

And so, this is the story of this place.

projects.title: Windy Hill Neighborhood
projects.subtitle: Microclimate & Hillside Urbanism
projects.description: A residential neighborhood design tailored to the hilly terrain of Bao Loc. The master plan respects existing contours through non-intrusive road networks, low-rise garden housing typologies, permeable surface drainage, and walkable public facilities to maintain harmony with the highland landscape.

seo.metaDescription: Terrain-sensitive low-impact residential clustering designed to capture prevailing hillside wind corridors.

projects.title: Central Lake Eco Park
projects.subtitle: Urban Hydrology & Wetland Park Masterplan
projects.description: An urban landscape design rooted in Sponge City principles and wetland restoration. By aligning with natural hydrological cycles and existing marshland topographies, the project establishes a multi-tiered detention basin system, eco-cultural habitats, and public recreational corridors for the emerging central core of District 2.

seo.metaDescription: Integrating urban stormwater catchment systems into a sprawling public bio-filtration park.

projects.title: CUXA (S.COMECO) - Smart, Community and Eco Housing
projects.subtitle: Sustainable Social Housing Typology
projects.description: Reimagining the traditional "Cư Xá" (historic housing complex) typologies in Thanh Da following the COVID-19 lockdowns. The project introduces prototype "healing residential buildings" equipped with flexible public spaces, micro-economic street markets, green facades, and passive ventilation to foster social resilience and community well-being.

seo.metaTitle: Cư Xá (S.COMECO) - Smart, Community and Eco Housing | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: Affordable modular living units prioritizing natural cross-ventilation and communal courtyard interactions.

projects.title: The Reborn of Water Reservoirs (Thuy Dai)
projects.subtitle: Adaptive Reuse of Heritage Water Towers
projects.description: An adaptive reuse initiative aimed at revitalizing Ho Chi Minh City’s historic water towers (Thuy Dai)-abandoned industrial landmarks-into an interconnected network of public art spaces, cultural hubs, and tourism spots. The design breathes new life into neglected urban voids while celebrating civic history and modern community programs.

seo.metaTitle: The Reborn of Water Reservoirs (Thuy Dai) | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: Repurposing colonial-era water reservoirs into public community cistern-parks and gathering hubs.

projects.title: Sun of Love - "Will to Live" Center
projects.subtitle: Universal Inclusive Design & Healing Architecture
projects.description: A specialized support center designed for individuals with disabilities, integrating vocational training, education, and accessible living spaces. Inspired by traditional Central Vietnamese roof structures, the project fuses climate-responsive passive strategies with barrier-free, universal design principles and tactile material orientation to empower vulnerable communities.

seo.metaTitle: Sun of Love - "Will to Live" Center | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: Barrier-free vocational center designed for youth with physical disabilities, embedding light as therapy.

projects.title: Saigon in Sight - Van Don Area Urban Design Guidelines
projects.subtitle: Urban Design & Waterfront Framework
projects.description: Comprehensive urban design guidelines established for neighborhood commercial, downtown, and mixed-use districts in District 4. The project proposes structured spatial frameworks, public realm interventions, active street frontage controls, and scenic waterfront pedestrian pathways along the Ben Nghe Canal to enhance urban connectivity and vitality

seo.metaTitle: Saigon in Sight - Van Don Area Urban Design Guidelines | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: Regeneration framework for Saigon waterfront nodes, balancing commercial density and public access.

projects.title: ROCRAS - Reborn of Coalmine Restoration and Sustainability
projects.subtitle: Ecological Mine Rejuvenation & Coastal Civic Basin
projects.description: A 1/5000 scale zoning plan for the Nui Beo open-pit coal mine and its surrounding urban areas. Inspired by the philosophy of Kintsugi (celebrating imperfection), the project aims to heal landscape scars by transforming a degraded post-mining area into a resilient, vibrant, and sustainable urban ecosystem. The master plan balances ecological restoration, industrial heritage preservation, and long-term socio-economic livelihoods.

seo.metaTitle: ROCRAS - Reborn of Coalmine Restoration and Sustainability | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: Transforming post-extraction mining voids into self-sustaining ecological wetland networks.

projects.title: The Veil - National Art Museum of Andorra
projects.subtitle: International Architecture Competition
projects.description:
Designed for the 120 Hours 2024 International Competition-reinterpreting the Pritzker-exclusive prompt for the National Art Museum of Andorra-The Veil addresses economic stagnation and cultural identity in the heart of the Pyrenees. Positioned as a catalyst for economic revitalization and spatial transformation, the museum balances global architectural appeal with local authenticity.   
The project conceptualizes a "tree-like" structure made of vertical steel poles that release water vapor to form a cloud-like canopy and reflecting layer, echoing the surrounding pine forests, mountain mist, and cascading waterfalls. By blurring the boundaries between historical heritage, natural landscape, and contemporary art, The Veil stands as a timeless sanctuary reflecting the spirit of Andorra.

seo.metaTitle: The Veil - National Art Museum of Andorra | Baropholio
seo.metaDescription: A contextual veil mediating historical stone topography with contemporary museum volumes.
